_note: Local businesses that support the Daily Brief. A lean directory — name, what they do, website, phone. Supporters have NO input into coverage. Business supporter tier: see businessSupport in site.json (price and join link). Add each business here after it joins. Fields: name (required), what, website, phone. Supporters that also appear in the business directory get a '★ Supporter' badge there automatically (matched by name); add directoryName if the directory lists them under a different name. The badge never changes their position in the directory. Set footer: false to keep a supporter off the site-wide 'Supported by' footer line. Audio sponsor tag: add "audio": {"line": "what they do, in a short phrase", "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD"} (start/end optional; line up to ~20 words / 220 characters) and the daily audio brief ends with "Today's Daily Brief is supported by <name>, <line>. Learn more at waynesville dot news slash supporters." before the sign-off. Several audio sponsors take turns by day; none = no tag. The brief page and podcast episode then show 'Supported by <name>'.
